verdicts.reason: A is a reasonable left-to-right banner: brand and badge on the left, the can in the middle, and headline, subline and CTA stacked on the right. Its flaws: the CTA is oversized and sits about 12px from the right edge, the badge nearly touches the left edge, and the logo is moved below the badge and shrunk inside the circle. B breaks the subline into a five-line column ('golden / hour.') stranded between the can and the CTA, out of reading order. B also splits the headline over two lines, leaves a wide gap between the badge and the logo, and the logo wordmark renders as 'SOLST CE', which damages the brand.
